card.name: Words before a drug class noun
card.fires_on: Small words like "another", "or", "a" or "P" that come right before a drug class or type noun such as insulin, short-acting insulin, P-gp inhibitors or DPP-4 inhibitor. Mostly in switching or concomitant-use statements.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward words like "agent" as the next word, naming a drug class.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a drug class name, as in "switching from another (insulin)".
